## Problem / 问题

Describe the concrete failure or requirement.
描述具体问题。

## Resulting behavior / 修改后的行为

Describe what changes for users and which evidence gates are affected.
说明用户行为变化及影响到的证据检查。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] Repository validator passes / 结构检查通过
- [ ] Relevant adversarial tests pass / 对应拦截测试通过
- [ ] Skill, policies and scripts remain consistent / 指令与代码一致
- [ ] No research files or credentials included / 无论文或凭证

## Limits / 边界

State any remaining source, interpretation or compatibility limitations.
说明仍存在的来源、解读或兼容性限制。
